implementation_findings.crack_band_length: builder obtains actual selected-plane cut geometry; modeLengthM = referenceVolumeM3 / referenceAreaM2
implementation_findings.fully_failed_cohesive_capacity_area: when available, stage analyzer sums activated reference face area times the fraction of its three equal quadrature points whose accepted damage is exactly 1; denominator is activated reference area
implementation_findings.geometric_open_area: geometric_crack_area_fraction and geometric_debond_area_fraction remain null; stage output and comparison explicitly keep these missing rather than aliasing model damage or capacity loss
implementation_findings.resolution_gates: resolution-study consumer requires explicit paper_damage_area_fraction and debond_area_fraction when corresponding feature flags are enabled; both differences use existing 0.02 threshold. Stage-study capacity-loss comparison remains descriptive and separate from geometric open area.
implementation_findings.stage_history_damage: paper and cohesive damage indices are area-weighted model-history indices, with active reference area exported separately

orientation_energy_test_gap: existing retained-matrix test had Gc*A closure and 2x refinement for an axis-aligned pure-mode history; its rotated-plane history required positive work only. New test checks actual 240-step full-softening work under a rigidly rotated reference tetra with unchanged material-frame channels, and reversed vertex winding, using the existing 2% Gc*A and same-work gates.
